messages:
Chen Li: Hi all 5 just unboxed my gear. Dock lights up but laptop battery icon says "Power Source: AC (Not Charging)" and external 27" LG monitor stays asleep. Any quick checks?
Sam (IT): @Chen Li welcome! Could you confirm dock model (sticker underside) and the power brick wattage? Also try a different USB-C port on your laptop if you have one, and run `system_profiler SPPowerDataType` and paste the output line that mentions AC details.
Chen Li: Dock sticker: USB4-DOCK-05, SN: U4-5590. Brick label: 45W. I attached a quick photo. I ran `system_profiler SPPowerDataType` - shows: "AC Charger: Connected" and "Charging: No". Tried both USB-C ports 5 same.
Sam (IT): 45W is likely the culprit for a 14" laptop with discrete GPU. Dock should provide pass-through PD >= 90W. We'll swap to a 100W brick + new dock. Before we RMA, quick firmware check: can you open the dock config page? (plug in via USB-A temporarily) If not, no problem 5 we'll just RMA.
Chen Li: I don't have a USB-A cable handy. Remote-only here. Shipping swap works.
Ava Onboarding: Hey @Chen Li welcome to Redwood! If you want a temporary workaround, we can overnight a laptop charger to you today. Otherwise itinerary: IT will ship replacement dock + 100W PS in ~48 hrs.
deploy-bot: Ticket #81234 created by Sam (IT): "USB4-DOCK-05 delivering 45W - laptop not charging, monitor not detected" 5 priority: P2 5 ETA replacement parts 2 business days.
Sam (IT): Please confirm shipping address and whether it's OK to include a USB-C -> DisplayPort dongle in the box (some docks need explicit DP alt mode). Also let us know if you need the monitor driver/firmware link.
Chen Li: Shipping: 1426 Willow Rd, Unit 2, Menlo Park, CA 94025. Yes please include DP dongle. Monitor model is LG 27UL850. I don't need driver for now. Thanks!
Sam (IT): Got it. Sending overnight charger now, replacement dock + 100W brick + DP dongle by standard ground. I added tracking to ticket #81234. If the overnight charger doesn't arrive in 24h ping me and we'll escalate.
Chen Li: Great, thanks everyone. Appreciate the speedy help. :pray:
